To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of a high-level model to generate the configuration of a NoC-based platform with configurable NI is a feasible and promising approach.
the proposed method and tools allow the efficient deployment of applications with configurable NI on IP and NoCs based platform.
we provide methods and tools to efficiently deploy applications on configurable IP and NoC platform.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues: - How to model the HW platform with a focus on the Network Interface? - How to model an application and its mapping on an abstract platform model?
the following aspects: - The definition of a generic and abstract description of the IP-based platform and of the applications.

the following topics: - Design of configurable Network Interfaces for NoC-based platforms - Design and deployment of applications on NoC-based platforms with configurable NIs - Code generation for configurable NIs - Design and deployment environment for NoC-based platform with configurable NIs
Design environment for the deployment of applications on IP-based platforms with configurable Network Interfaces.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our approach allows to deploy efficiently applications on configurable NoC platforms with NI, by taking into account the architectural and mapping information.
the proposed design methodology is able to efficiently generate the configuration of a complex application for a given IP-based platform with a high level of abstraction.

the proposed approach allows for a significant reduction in the design effort, and for an increase of the quality of the resulting system, by taking advantage of a high level design flow and a code generation tool, and of the use of a formal description of the platform and of the application.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a design environment to efficiently deploy applications on NoC-based platform with configurable NI.
we have developed a methodology to support the configuration of the Network Interfaces and the mapping of applications on a heterogeneous IP platform.
our tool chain provides a complete solution for mapping and deployment of applications on configurable NI.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of a high level description of the HW platform and of the application, together with a model of the mapping and the deployment flow, is a key enabler to efficiently deploy applications on complex IP-based platforms with configurable NI.
the deployment of applications on NoC platforms can be done in an efficient and easy manner.
the proposed approach allows to efficiently generate the configurations of complex IP-based platform and to easily deploy applications on such platform.
